scientific_integrity: Analytic proof over all claimed dimensions and parameters, complemented by a standalone reproducibility check; numerical experiments do not assert proof or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The stochastic-order theorem holds for orthogonal rectangular tori and their inversion quotients, not all oblique tori. The quotient metric is intrinsic; the parameter class is restricted to positive side lengths. The proof invokes Prékopa marginal log-concavity and compact-group Haar pushforward. Independent historical-priority and mathematical audit have not been performed; a potentially related 1996 cube-ball source was bibliographically identified but its full text was unavailable. The 1973 Prékopa citation has only a verified publication year, not an exact original public day; 2005-05-25 is the earliest exact-day first-public date verified among the motivating arXiv sources.
title: Schur ordering and exact geodesic pair-distance laws on flat inversion orbifolds
